overall_notes: Paper focuses on factual consistency evaluation for text summarization. The extraction quality is generally good, but needed to distinguish between evaluation metrics vs. analysis tools. Paper uses LLM as evaluator (FLAN-PaLM) to label summaries for factual consistency, then distills this knowledge into smaller models. Human evaluation was conducted by domain experts with specific expertise in factual consistency evaluation.
